class.name: NaniteDAG
class.brief_description: Offline cluster hierarchy used by virtualized geometry.
class.description: A directed acyclic graph of triangle clusters built at import time from a single mesh surface. Level 0 holds the original geometry split into clusters of at most 128 triangles; each level above is produced by grouping clusters, simplifying each group as a unit, and splitting the result into clusters again, until nothing merges any more. At render time a [i]cut[/i] through the graph is chosen from a screen-space error threshold, mixing detail levels across a single mesh. Error and bounds are properties of a whole group rather than of individual clusters, so every cluster of a group changes detail level together; that, together with locking the vertices on a group's boundary during simplification, is what keeps a cut free of cracks. Errors are absolute, in mesh units, and never decrease towards the root. [method validate] checks that and the graph's other invariants. [b]Note:[/b] the stored layout is provisional and may change between builds. Reimport the source mesh rather than relying on a saved graph.

method.name: create_cut_debug_mesh
method.description: Returns a mesh of the clusters selected at [param threshold], each cluster in its own color. Useful for seeing which detail levels a given threshold mixes.

method.name: create_level_debug_mesh
method.description: Returns a mesh of every cluster on [param level], each cluster in its own color.

method.name: get_cluster_analytic_error
method.description: Returns a deviation the simplification that produced [param cluster] provably cannot exceed, in mesh units. Unlike [method get_cluster_error] this is derived rather than sampled, so it holds without qualification - but it assumes a flat triangle departs from the surface by its own radius, and on real geometry runs one to two orders of magnitude larger. The runtime cut uses the measured value; this exists for consumers needing a guarantee, and so the ratio between the two is visible.

method.name: get_cluster_error
method.description: Returns how far the surface moved when [param cluster] was produced, in mesh units: the largest deviation found at the sampling density recorded on the graph, measured in both directions between the original geometry and the simplified result. This is a measured maximum rather than a proven bound, which is why the sampling density travels with the graph. Zero for level 0, which is the unsimplified input. See [method get_cluster_analytic_error] for the derived counterpart.

method.name: get_cluster_parent_error
method.description: Returns the error of the group that would replace [param cluster] with coarser geometry, in mesh units, or [constant @GDScript.INF] if it is a root and nothing coarser exists. Together with [method get_cluster_error] this gives the interval of thresholds over which the cluster is the right choice: it is drawn when its own error is within the threshold but its replacement's is not.

method.name: get_cluster_count
method.description: Returns the total number of clusters across all levels.

method.name: get_cluster_vertex_count
method.description: Returns the number of distinct vertices referenced by the cluster at index [param cluster].

method.name: get_group_count
method.description: Returns the number of groups. A group is the set of clusters that were simplified together to produce the level above.

method.name: get_level_cluster_count
method.description: Returns how many clusters make up [param level].

method.name: get_level_count
method.description: Returns the number of levels, counting level 0.

method.name: get_level_distinct_vertex_count
method.description: Returns how many distinct vertices [param level] touches, which is what a shared vertex buffer would need to store for it.

method.name: get_level_max_error
method.description: Returns the largest error of any cluster on [param level], in mesh units. This never decreases as levels go up.

method.name: get_level_triangle_count
method.description: Returns the total triangle count of [param level].

method.name: get_level_vertex_slice_total
method.description: Returns the summed vertex count of every cluster on [param level], which is what giving each cluster its own vertex slice would cost. Compare with [method get_level_distinct_vertex_count] to see the duplication that layout pays for locality.

method.name: get_report
method.description: Returns a per-level table of cluster counts, triangle counts, errors and vertex usage, for judging the quality of the hierarchy.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns the same figures as [method get_report] as a [Dictionary], for programmatic use. Keys are [code]level_count[/code], [code]cluster_count[/code], [code]group_count[/code], [code]triangle_count[/code], [code]vertex_count[/code], and [code]levels[/code] - an [Array] with one [Dictionary] per level holding [code]clusters[/code], [code]triangles[/code] and [code]max_error[/code].

method.name: get_triangle_count
method.description: Returns the total triangle count across all levels.

method.name: select_cut
method.description: Returns the clusters that should be drawn at error threshold [param threshold], in mesh units. A cluster is selected when its own error is within the threshold but the error of the group that would replace it is not.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns a description of every violated invariant, or an empty array if the graph is sound. Checks that error never decreases towards the root, that each group's bounding sphere encloses its children's, that all clusters of a group share one detail decision, and that indices and back-references are in range.
